text: Second BoltOdds key: it reached GitHub (engine restarted on it); I'm confirming the key count and whether it works in a few minutes. Sockets today: Novig = stream on both the phone and the engine; BoltOdds = sockets on both (the engine's snapshot is what hits the 429); Kalshi = a socket on the PHONE once its key is entered (Settings > Kalshi, Test key); the GitHub engine reads Kalshi by plain public requests, no socket. One question before I touch anything: do you mean (a) enter the Kalshi key in the phone so the phone's socket runs (already built, nothing to send), or (b) send the Kalshi key to GitHub so the engine uses a socket too? (b) puts a key that can place trades into a GitHub secret (the Novig key sent there is read-only; Kalshi's can't be limited like that), so I won't do it unless you say yes to that.
